# Lobo Prints

Lobo Prints provides custom apparel printing and merchandise branding in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.

## Core services
- Custom t-shirt printing
- Custom hoodies and sweatshirts
- Custom sports jerseys and teamwear
- Custom trackpants, shorts, and jackets
- Custom caps, badges, ID cards, and mugs
- Corporate uniforms and event merchandise

## Who we serve
- Colleges and student events
- Corporate teams and HR programs
- Sports teams and clubs
- Startups, creators, and communities
- Event organizers

## Design workflow
1. Choose a product from categories or all products.
2. Use Design Lab to add logo and text.
3. Submit requirements through quote form or WhatsApp.
4. Review digital mockup from Lobo Prints.
5. Approve and proceed with production.
